items.text: Hey everyone! Today, we are releasing a minor update (Update 2.1) for Godbreakers!

This patch introduces a brand-new threat to the world of Astaphan: the Ray Fin, wielding the new ability that players can try out, the Solar Ray. We’ve also expanded the Savage Blade’s arsenal with the new Counter Slash ability, alongside a suite of ability reworks and quality-of-life improvements to keep your runs feeling smooth. Additionally, we’ve tuned the Duelist and Pillar archetypes to ensure their kits feel more powerful and rewarding than ever.
Read the full patch notes here 👇

releases.displayName: Godbreakers Free Winter Update Patch Note!

items.text: Hey everyone,

We’re excited to share a preview of our biggest content update yet: Godbreakers Winter Update (also known as Update 2)! This free update is dropping on December 11th on PC and PS5! Adding a brand-new Archetype, a new game mode, a server browser, leaderboards, and much more! Read below to get the full patch notes for the free Winter Update.

notes.title: New ways to play with others

items.text: Godbreakers shines the brightest when playing with others, and we want to make it as easy as possible to find people to play with. Our intention was always to add a Server Browser, and now we can finally bring it to you! The Server browser lets you team up with players from all over the world. We also know some of you like to push the limits, and now you have the chance to show off your skills globally or compete with friends on the new Leaderboards!

At the time of writing these patch notes, we are now at day 43 of getting requests on Discord for a Great sword... A special thanks to Discord user Omeni_ for kicking off this “movement” :) We’re happy to introduce our version of the Great Sword: the Savage Blade! To unlock this new archetype, you need to complete a set of challenges, and you can try it in our new game mode: Recollections! With Recollections, you can experience Godbreakers in new, challenging ways. In addition, The Monad has crafted three new enemies for you to fight - absorb their abilities to gain new powers!

You can now experience greater variety and depth in our build crafting. Now, all essences have a unique trait that you can unlock! Be strategic with the essences you are stacking to unlock these traits. To further improve the build-crafting, there is now an increased number of equipment items that can appear at the beginning of a run, making it more interesting each time you start a run.
Keep reading to get all the details of this big update, and get ready to go Berserk!

Players can now host, browse, and join open games via a new server browser! Making it easier than ever to play with others. You can now find people online to team up with and create new crews taking on the gods! We have also added the ability to view the party and kick players.

Unlock the new, broadsword-wielding Archetype with the ability to enter the devastating Berserk mode. This Archetype is all about risk management, as taking damage will push you closer to going Berserk, giving your deadly swings and thrusts higher attack speed.

Once Berserk, you can quickly regain any lost health if you play aggressively, since all your attacks now have the Leech effect. By staying in the thick of the fight and allowing weak attacks to hit you occasionally, you can stay Berserk for longer.
Unlockable weapon ability.
Unlockable weapon skins.

Test your skills in seven bite-sized, single-biome challenges that introduce completely new modifiers to the game. Survive a bullet hell in Astaphanes' garden, where every enemy can fire multiple projectiles. Crack diamond-scaled enemies using explosions and electricity, and face off against an overpowered Monad in one of the toughest challenges yet.
Seven timed challenges using unique modifiers and builds.
Complete these to unlock new tangles for the standard game mode.
Specific cosmetic unlocks are tied to Recollections.

We have added a run score for completed runs: each tangle you add to your run acts as a score multiplier. Scores can be viewed on the global and friends Leaderboards, so that players can compete for the top spot as the best Godbreaker in the universe.
We are introducing some more enemies, along with new abilities to absorb.
Marik’s world gets the new Haymaker enemy and its Whirlwind ability.
Uhr gets the Pulsar enemy along with its Ball Lightning ability.
All biomes receive a new pinecone enemy, the Stomper, and its Explosive Ascent ability.
We have added new Elite Types to give players more challenge and variety.
Rampager Elite - Gives all nearby enemies stacks of Rampage.
Artillery Elite - Occasionally creates a ring of projectiles and fires them outwards.
Armoring Elite - Gives all nearby enemies stacks of Armor.
Barrier Elite - Able to create a blocking Barrier.
New Equipment Items
We have added new items to the Equipment list to give players more options when crafting unique builds.
Gravity Orb - Throw an orb that pulls in and stuns enemies.
Electric Trap - Throw out three traps that deal electric damage.
Electric Aura - Create an electric discharge around yourself.
Electric Orb - Throw an orb that creates an electric discharge.
DOT Detonator - Consumes a DOT on all nearby enemies and explodes them.
Piercing Ray - Target up to 3 enemies, dealing damage and making them Vulnerable.
We have added more Tangels, along with rewards for beating the game with these Tangels active.
Doomsday Clock - Each biome has a time limit. Complete the biome before time runs out or face elimination.
Completing this tangle will unlock the Savage Blade Archetype.
Vague Portents - Danger Zones are visible for a shorter time.
Completing this tangle will unlock the Savage Blade Weapon Ability Whirling Vortex.
Gladiator’s Revenge - An extra Gladiator will appear in each world.
Completing this tangle will unlock the Bandana head.
Dredger’s Revenge - An extra Dredger will appear in each world.
Completing this tangle will unlock the Edge of Thorns appearance for the Savage blade.
Compiler’s Revenge - An extra Compiler will appear in each world.
Completing this tangle will unlock the Disco Freak head.
Synthesist’s Revenge - An extra Synthesist will appear in each world.
Completing this tangle will unlock the Mullet head.
License to die - Taking any damage will kill you.
Completing this tangle will unlock the Black Hole Sun material.
Combat Challenge Rooms
Now there is a chance that a room in a biome will contain a timed combat challenge, allowing skilled players to earn more loot.
Fragments that have a trait upgrade will have it visible on their card at all times.
Essence Traits
Each essence now comes with an added trait that comes into effect once you have collected enough essences of a specific type.
Crit Damage Essence has been merged into Crit Master Essences Trait.
Prismatic Essence has been merged into Manifestation Essence Trait.
Exposed Vulnerability - Hitting a target that has Vulnerable will refresh the duration.
Toxic Tendencies - Enemies that die with Poison will explode, applying Poison to nearby enemies.
Heat Disperseal - When Burning is applied to an enemy, a fire pool forms beneath it.
Necrotic Wounds - Increase damage on all DOTs.
Electric Touch - Spawns an Electric orb after a certain number of Chain Lightning jumps.
Potent Discharge - Explosions apply Unstable (enemies that die with Unstable will explode).
Crit Master - Chance to get a Mega Crit.
Sprinter - Gain invulnerability when dashing.
Revenge - Gain Armor after reflecting.
Manifestation - Gain 100% Source-Light Generation after using an Absorbed Ability.
Thread Count - Gain Barrier after taking 100 damage in a single hit.
Band-Aid’s Blessing - Gain Leech when going below 30% HP.
Opportune Strike has been reworked and comes with an added trait when upgraded.
Trait: Witches’ Mark: Combo Attacks deal 10% more Damage for each Debuff on the target.
Combined Torment now comes with an added trait when upgraded.
Trait: Torment Overload: When a DOT is consumed, create an aura that spreads the DOT to other nearby enemies.
Sentinel Booster has been replaced by the new fragment Sentinel Discharge.
Drastically increased the number of equipment that can appear from the Echo of Zeal.
All Aura Traps have their radius increased also gained knockback
Fiery Temper has been renamed Fiery Aura and has a larger radius and knockback.
Noxious Splatter has been renamed Noxious Aura and has a larger radius and knockback.
Entropic Aura has a larger radius and knockback.
All Trap equipment will now spawn three traps instead of one. Trap Equipment damage has been rebalanced to now spawn three traps instead of one.
Noxious Trap
Fiery Trap
Electrip Trap
Entropic trap
The following Equipment Items have had their cooldown times adjusted:
Thorn Shield Generator
Primal Energy Generator
Uhr’s Blessing, Exploding Trap
Electric Trap

Noxious Aura
Electric Aura
Fiery Aura
The Lancer’s Vector Thrust ability damage has been increased.
The Duelist’s Energy Mines ability spawns five mines instead of three.
The Twin Blades’ Assassin's Guild ability now lasts 8 seconds instead of 4.
The Reaper’s Sentinel Meteor ability description is now updated to include Explosion damage.
The Charge Attack is now considered a Secondary Attack.
Monad
Summon Archon ability now scales as intended between phases.
Added “Restart run” button to main menu and Win/Lose screen.
Fixed so that the Pillar’s Trait Seismic Capacitor gives one stack of Quake for each enemy hit with a Secondary Attack instead of just one stack.
Fixed crash in damage calculation.
Fixed a crash in the attribute widget if the character with the attribute dies.
Fix the issue where the player could get stuck with infinite absorbed abilities.
Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in the Archon aspect created by the Monad.
Adjusted some aggressive performance culling that caused certain VFX for player materials to not show up correctly on lower graphics settings.
Tweaked some collisions in the Marik biome to give a better movement experience.
Adjusted the position of Ergos in the Monad starting area.
Fixed collision in the monad starting area to better match the platform.
Fixed minor issues with several Fragments.
More minor fixes and tweaks!

releases.displayName: The big Winter Update is coming December 11

items.text: We are thrilled to finally announce that Update 2, the Godbreakers Winter Update, launches on December 11!

This big content update is bringing lots of new features and content, a brand-new archetype: Savage Blade, server browser for easier ways to play with others online, new enemies & absorbed abilities, new game mode, and a big update for essences. This is not all for the Godbreakers Winter Update, as we want to keep some surprises for when it goes live on December 11!
The Winter Update is our most ambitious release yet, designed to deliver fresh new content and challenges for you to experience on your own or with fellow Godbreakers!

Until we are ready to share more about the other big features coming up, let’s take a closer look at the Savage Blade. We are introducing Savage Blade, a high-risk, high-reward broadsword-wielding Archetype with the ability to enter the devastating Berserk mode. This Archetype is all about risk management, as taking damage will push you closer to going Berserk, giving your deadly swings and thrusts higher attack speed.
Find out more about the full update in the patch notes on Dec 11th!
Also, here is the full image of all the puzzle pieces together:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718547/4d190aa7f819aa21f005bdef296604479c0636de.png"]
See you in the Winter Update!
/ To The Sky
Hey everyone! Today, we are releasing a new update for Godbreakers!

Currently, the team is focused and working hard on Update 2, but in between Update 1 and 2, we wanted to release a smaller patch to add some balancing fixes, improve some of the weaker Archetype abilities, make adjustments to some fragments and the economy, as well as fix several bugs.

For the Archetype abilities, we didn't want to be too crazy and completely overhaul them right now because we think most of them are in a good spot, but just need some tweaking. We may revisit some of them in the future if they require further work. We have mostly tweaked duration, damage, and size for now, but we will continue to monitor these as we progress.

Also, for this update, we haven’t touched the bosses because we believe their damage and health are in a good spot after Update 1, and most new players find the bosses to be a good challenge for them. One boss we did address was Monad; we increased the speed of each explosion when a phase shift occurs. For phases 2 and 3, you will see it run a bit faster than before, and it has also been tweaked to summon the aspects of the other Hylarians.
The duration between each explosion in the “Collapsing Star” move has been shortened.
The Cooldown for the Summon Aspects ability has been adjusted.
Dust Devil’s health has been increased.
The amount of Dust currency dropping in each biome has been decreased.
The amount of Echoes currency that drops has been decreased.
The amount of Ballistica kills needed to unlock the Reaper Archetype has been increased.
The amount of Backstabs needed to unlock the Twin Blade Archetype has been increased.
The number of Boss kills needed to unlock the Duelist Archetype has been increased.
The Vitalizing Havoc Tangle’s effect has been increased from 10% to 20%.
The Shell Shield cooldown has been increased from 30 sec to 35 sec.
The range for the Godbreak Shield’s trait, Erosive Emissions, has been increased from 3m to 5m.
The chance of getting back Source-Light from Prismatic Discharge has been increased.
Base item: From 20% to 25%
Upgraded version: From 40% to 50%
The Primary Attack damage decrease from Direct Approach has been lowered from 30% to 25%.
The damage of the Reaper’s Sentinel Meteor ability has been increased.
The damage from the Reaper’s Sentinel Meteor now counts as Explosive Damage.
The radius of the Striker’s Berserker Totem ability has been increased.
The radius of the Duelist’s Sanctuary Zone ability has increased.
The radius and damage of the Twin Blade’s Blade Nova ability have increased.
The cooldown of the Lancer’s Morphic Summon ability has increased.
Fixed some issues with some fragment abilities having a higher chance to proc than what was stated in their description.
Fixed an issue with unlocking the Striker’s Vector Blast ability.
Fixed an issue with the Twin Blade’s trait to give the player increased crit chance if the Assassin's Guild ability is active.
Fixed an issue where players are not rewarded with the Star Seed Material when completing the Heliocentric Challenge in co-op.
Fixed a crash when killing Sabboath with Reflect damage.
Fixed a crossplay error between Epic and Steam, previously preventing some players from playing between the platforms.
Various stability improvements.

Before the end of the year, we will also release Update 2, which is a significant one! Update 2 is going to include new content in the form of a brand new Archetype: The Savage Blade, The Server Browser, New Enemy Variants with new Abilities, bigger changes to Essences, more balancing, and much, much more!
Whoa there… what in the world is this? 👀
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718547/18d836bda7c48c2908df6543320c6386b14e13be.png"]More puzzle pieces are coming, so stay alert for more teasers! 👀

notes.title: Today we launch our first free update for Godbreakers, as well as a Halloween themed DLC in time for the spooky season.

items.text: The free update adds six new challenges that unlock brand-new cosmetics, which combine to create a fun beekeeper style outfit, an astronaut outfit and a hockey outfit. Two new Tangles: Chronic Collapse, making you stumble when your stamina is depleted, and Displaced, which teleports you in a random direction when you take direct damage. 12 new rooms have also been added throughout the game, giving more variety to biomes and a host of balances and improvements have been introduced as well!
We recently shared an update outlining what's ahead for Godbreakers, including our plans for future update before the end of the year. You can read the full announcement here:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2687400/view/599667883291705395"]

4 New Astaphane rooms
4 New Sabboath rooms
4 New Kar-Aja rooms
We have added two new Tangles that will challenge even the most seasoned Godbreakers.
Chronic Collapse - Stumble when all your stamina is depleted.
Displaced - Taking direct damage will teleport you in a random direction.
* Tangles become available after you have beaten the Monad for the first time.

“We all wear masks, because a face implies we have some sort of inside, but behind these masks, there is simply another mask. It’s masks all the way down.” - Kethena Celebrate the season of veils and trickery with six new unlockable Cosmetics.

Hockey Stick skin for the Reaper - Unlock Challenge: Slap Shots - As the Reaper Archetype, let your Swarm Sentinels kill Astaphane.

Beekeeper - Unlock Challenge: Queen Bee - Spawn 100 Sentinels.

releases.displayName: Godbreakers Demo Content Update Strikes on Oct 9

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718547/9db520454d59d77b7b331ab2327681bf51985b28.png"]

We are excited to share that we are a part of the Beat ‘em Up Games Party, A special celebration of fist-swinging, combo-crushing, crowd-clearing action spanning from October 9 to 15! We are also pulling our punches with a big new update for the Godbreakers demo available on the same day!
This is what will be included in the update 👇

Introducing Marik: Explore the recently added biome of Marik, featuring entirely new environmental challenges, three unique enemy types, and a formidable main boss awaiting to challenge you at the end. Marik's muscular frame embodies the Monad’s will to dominate, serving as its enforcer and guardian of the final hierarchy.

Expanded Run: You can now finally traverse between both the UHR and Marik biomes in a single run! This expanded session will allow you to truly experience the progression and power fantasy of your evolving build.

Tangles: Discover a sneak peek of our Tangles system, which allows you to modify each run with distinct challenges. Three unique Tangles are now unlockable in the demo, offering a glimpse into the diverse possibilities of the full game. For example, when the Parting Gift tangle is active, defeated enemies leave mines behind.
New Cosmetic Flair: Personalize your character with two new cosmetic options: the Gladiator Head and the Ergos Head! Make sure you look ready for the battle ahead.

You might remember our last update brought 13 new languages to the demo making the demo more accessible for more players. For this one, though, we really wanted to deliver on gameplay variety. We figured it was time to shake things up with new challenges and more ways to play Godbreakers!

Seriously, the support from all of you has been amazing. We're beyond excited to hear what you think of everything in this updated demo. Your input is invaluable! Godbreakers is releasing on 23 October, 2025!
